protocol.selection: The two group illustrations were chosen after exploratory stress testing; these descriptive controls were specified afterward
protocol.purpose: Separate withdrawal magnitude from the concentration of records in the named group for these illustrations only
protocol.sampling: 1000 draws per illustration by default; equal global distinct-record count; all candidate compounds reranked
protocol.interpretation: Simulation fractions are not error probabilities, p-values, clinical validation, independent replication, or general evidence of group specificity
protocol.tail_order: Unsupported is at least as adverse as every supported rank; if structured outcome is unsupported only unsupported draws qualify
protocol.known_difference: Uniform controls match global deletion count, not compound-specific deletion counts or source/experiment dependencies

scope.rng: NumPy Generator PCG64; uniform choice without replacement within each draw

structured_group_outcome.verification_method: edited CSR matrices and full sparse path products
